temporal_state_chain.observed: Christina argues that the marketing campaign should showcase dynamic, interactive sessions and balance innovation with traditional offerings.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Traditional teaching methods are the backbone of the center's success and should be prominently featured; shifting focus toward innovation risks alienating long-time attendees.

temporal_state_chain.intention: Organize resources and set up a schedule to roll out the blended project on a larger scale, while coordinating with Christina and marketing.

temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Strengthened; the positive feedback proves that blending methods was the right move and supports expansion to other centers.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The blended teaching project should be expanded to other centers because it is successful and beneficial.
